extDescription: Save, search, and copy API keys, tokens, and code snippets locally in your browser — without digging through .env files.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Manage how SnippetVault looks, saves, and organizes

workspace.title: Contexts & workspace
workspace.description: Context markers and default temporary expiry

taxonomy.title: Labels
taxonomy.description: Manage the labels used to organize snippets

storage.title: Storage
storage.description: Local data today and future backup options

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Follow the operating system or choose a fixed theme.

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the language used by SnippetVault surfaces.

shortcut.title: Search shortcut
shortcut.description: Double-Shift opens in-page search. The Chrome shortcut opens the search side panel, including on restricted pages.
shortcut.loadFailed: Could not load the current shortcut.
shortcut.openFailed: Could not open Chrome shortcut settings.

workspace.contextDescription: Combine a name and color to identify a project, provider, or environment.
workspace.contextSnapshotNotice: A snippet keeps the context name and color selected when it was saved. Later preset changes only affect future saves.
workspace.defaultDescription: Choose how many days a new temporary item remains available.
workspace.newItemsOnly: This only applies to new items. Existing expiry dates are not changed.
workspace.invalid: Enter a whole number of at least 1 day.
workspace.saveFailed: Could not save the default expiry.

taxonomy.archiveNotice: Hiding a label only removes it from future choices. Existing snippets keep their saved label.

storage.localDescription: Snippet content and metadata stay in this extension's local IndexedDB.
storage.r2Description: R2 credentials, backup, and restore controls will live here after the security model is designed.
storage.noticeDescription: SnippetVault does not upload data or store cloud credentials yet. Local data remains plaintext to anyone who can access this browser profile.

errors.internal: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.unauthorized: The message source could not be verified.
errors.labelLength: Label names must contain 1 to $1 characters.
errors.sourceTitleTooLong: The page title is too long.
errors.snippetConflict: This snippet changed elsewhere. Refresh the results and try again.
errors.expiryFuture: The expiry must be in the future.
errors.invalidResponse: The extension returned an unrecognized response.
errors.noResponse: The extension is not responding. Please try again.

tooltip.noLabelsHint: Type a label name below and press Enter
tooltip.selectLabelFirst: Choose or enter at least one label
tooltip.indexRebuild: The search index will rebuild on next startup
tooltip.labelGroup: Choose one or more labels for this snippet
tooltip.labelInputLabel: Enter a label, then press Enter to create and add it to the selection
tooltip.environmentSelectLabel: Choose a context; it is saved and searchable

input.vault: Search content, labels, context, or source…

dialog.title: Search SnippetVault
dialog.description: Search saved records or temporary workspace items

create.title: New snippet
create.vaultDescription: Enter text or Markdown and save it directly to the vault.
create.workspaceDescription: Save it to the temporary workspace using your default expiry.
create.workspaceLabelsHint: Optional. Choose labels when they make this temporary item easier to retrieve.

edit.title: Edit snippet
edit.vaultDescription: Update this record without changing its type or captured source.
edit.workspaceDescription: Update this temporary record and, if needed, its expiry.
edit.labelsHintWithArchived: Archived labels already on this snippet can be kept or removed; other archived labels are unavailable.
edit.archivedLabel: $1 is archived and remains available only on this snippet.
edit.expiryHint: Leave this unchanged to preserve the current expiry.
edit.expiryInvalid: Choose a future date and time.
edit.conflictDescription: Refresh the results, reopen the snippet, and apply your changes again.

results.vaultEmpty: Saved webpage selections with labels will appear here.
results.workspaceEmpty: Temporary items will appear here until they expire.
results.deleteConfirm: This action cannot be undone. The item will be permanently removed.

status.indexRebuild: Search index recovery is pending; results will rebuild automatically.
status.labelOrderStale: Label usage order will update later.
